note: Rewritten 2026-08-20 at v2.9.0. The previous state pointed at v1.3.0-era drafts in a navy/amber 'Ledger Equities Desk' style that was replaced at v2.0.0, and its index.html fingerprint had been stale for six versions. Those old drafts still exist on the canvas but are history -- do not iterate from them.
contextNote: index.html is ~93KB, well over the CLI's 50,000-character per-context-file cap. Generate a trimmed reference first (strip the <script> block, the favicon data URI, and long SVG path data, then cap leading indentation) -- that lands around 47KB and carries the markup plus the full stylesheet, which is all a visual draft needs.

36c7f028-8e05-433f-90e9-8db6bfe58f4c.title: Classic v3 - Spread Module + Confidence Readout
36c7f028-8e05-433f-90e9-8db6bfe58f4c.visualDirection: Keeps the arcade-neon identity and the 2-column grid untouched. Adds two things: Current Spread lifted out of the Live Price card into its own module (live spread pill + Robinhood link + a summary line), and a new Round Confidence module -- large percentage, YES/NO call, a certain-NO / neutral / certain-YES bar with a marker, a band badge, and evidence lines citing the Kalshi order book, the price-vs-strike position with time left, and historical precedent, closed by an explicit 'statistical estimate, not financial advice' line.

5f14f995-23d7-40e2-bb25-4a83ac792a80.title: The Board - Pegboard Trading Desk
5f14f995-23d7-40e2-bb25-4a83ac792a80.visualDirection: Executive Glassmorphism on a pegboard. Slim 64px icon rail, glass tiles on a 12-column grid with visible drag handles and corner resize grips over a dotted peg-hole texture, and a fixed 80px bottom status bar carrying three circular SVG meters (Round Progress / Lean Strength / Market Confidence) plus a pulsing LIVE dot and clock. Cyan #22d3ee primary, JetBrains Mono numerals. Market Intelligence tile carries the confidence percentage, a YES LIKELY band, and an AI-insight badge, marked 'probabilistic estimate only'. Draft leaves large dead space below the tiles -- the real build's upward compaction fixes that, and the draft has no spread-ledger tile.

3f7547d5-9103-4dbd-87ab-4d348960990f.title: The Gauge - Round Confidence Meter
3f7547d5-9103-4dbd-87ab-4d348960990f.visualDirection: Dark brutalist confidence page. One portrait card on #050505 with a multi-stop gradient border and an amber atmospheric bottom glow, a 98px glowing YES/NO call, a 150px ultra-light confidence percentage, three evidence rows (market odds / price position / historical precedent), a paired live-price and strike-target row with a delta pill, and a rounded-pill timeframe bar. KNOWN DRAFT BUG: the 16-cell segmented gauge rendered as full-width stacked horizontal lines rather than 16 side-by-side cells, and the four band labels overlap it -- build that component properly as a 16-column grid rather than porting the draft's markup.
